text: Worst burrito ever with service running very close. Chicken soaked in water. No taste. First bite into a mouth of gristle. My wife's was no better. Stay away

I come here all the time and get food and love the food and have always loved the service until now! I had jennifer and she was a total bitch! rude ass hell and needs to be fired ASAP! she took forever to greet us. then when she came to take our order rushed us and had no manners. when she came with the food, she said "here" and just like nudged me to take it, my friend asked for cheese and understood he may have to be charged and said "yea we are gonna charge yoy" with a very tasty tone. then my friend got the sandwich back & it had plastic in it! we waited for jennifer to come she never did, i to get up & look for the manager  who also didn't really care  either then she never came back to even check on us esp about the plastic. then another server took care of us the rest of the time she never came back i had to ask her for our checks and we didn't tip her! horrible woman and service

What a meal for $10. In a rewards member and eat at Chili's quite often while on the road nationwide. I usually order the Cajun chicken pasta because the steaks are usually tough and undercooked. I felt like a steak today and decided to give it a try. I'm so glad I did! This steak was cooked perfectly medium. I've only had comparably cooked steaks at Texas Roadhouse. The cut of steak wasn't as good, but whoever prepared it is an excellent chef. 
The service was quick and courteous. Waitress was excellent! Chips came out warm and fresh. I was given a refill quickly when my drink got to about half full. The loaded mashed potatoes were great as was the broccoli amazing enough. What a well ran restaurant. A refreshing surprise from the norm nowadays!

My wife and I came here during the night as she got a 2 for 1 buffet coupon there and decided to give it a shot. It was crab legs night.  The place is remodeled with the bathrooms and is upstairs.  The price was $26.99 I believe and if you have a players card you get a dollar off.  Even though it was biker's night, I was surprised the buffet was not crowded and we came around 7:30pm.  The line was not long and waited 15 minutes to get in.

Okay the atmosphere is really nice and the drinks are typical drinks, juice, soda and you can pay extra for alcohol if you like.  But one thing that does stand out that many people would not know about is you can ask them to add in the cherry, vanilla and forgot what else flavoring into the drink and I got a cherry lemonade that tastes like hot dog on a stick.

Selection was not too big compared to other buffets I been too like the El Dorado and Atlantis, but it is the quality that counts right.  Overall the food was just okay, they have a Mexican, Chinese and American station, and a huge dessert station.

What I like was the crab and kept on going for more. It did not taste old like other places I have been too and was just right.  The other food was just so so. Prime rib was actually good as well, but could not eat well because of my gout issue.  The salad bar was not too big and wish they had more different types of salads.

The fried chicken was dry as well.  They have a pasta station as well, but did not load up on that as it is carb a

I first experienced the little known big taste of the chicken wings at The Friendly several years ago. I finally got back there today, but took a friend who'd not tasted the crispy, perfectly seasoned, and fried  hand-held pieces of meat. We split a full order and still took some home!

#Getlostindiana

The best burger awards around the restaurant are well deserving. One of the best burgers in south jersey. My only gripe is the limiting seating for groups of 4, no coca-cola or pepsi products, and the price is on the higher side.
Delicious food and friendly staff!! Great price for a generous portion. One of my favorite spots!

Really enjoyed our brunch!  Everything was very delicious!   There was a wait but not terribly long. However the wait for food was a bit long, with that being said they have only been open 10 days and they were very busy. The staff was very friendly. When the waitress said the biscuits were huge, she wasn't lying. As musician Jimmy Hall would say, "they were as big as your fist and dripping with sweet creamy butter."  (Actually I believe it was maple butter). YUM!  They also were great!!  So pleased to have a new place for brunch!
Make sure to give this place a try!  I didn't have the Bloody Mary but I believe I will next time!

We had a wonderful Christmas dinner here a couple of weeks ago. Reservations on Open Table was not available due to our size and time; however, I simply called and they were able to get us on the books with a credit card hold. I arrived a little early and our table was ready, but waited for everyone to arrive to be seated. 

Located at the bottom of the Westin (different entrance), there's free valet parking with validation. The restaurant itself is beautiful open, tall ceilings with a beautiful staircase going to the second story, where our table was. 

The food was all delicious! For our appetizers, we ordered the ice chest and added king crab legs - everything was fresh and delicious. For my entree, I had the 8 oz filet and added the scallop oscar. The steak was cooked perfectly, seasoned well, and came out hot. The scallops were sweet and tender with the perfect amount of sauce and some served on the side. We also ordered almost all of the sides to share and the were all really good!Tthe mac and cheese was creamy deliciousness, crispy brussels was yum, couldn't stop eating the truffle fries, I love mushrooms! For dessert, we shared the chocolate layer cake, the tropical cheesecake, and the carrot cake. Chocolate cake was the best, the carrot cake was a bit dry.

We had a party of 9 girls, and they did not miss a beat. The entire staff was accommodating, but our server went above and beyond. Ensuring we had the best photo! You are able to bring your own wine if its not one

Fantastic food and it's rather inexpensive as well. Not cheap,. cheap denoted poor quality and this food is outstanding.

The staff is friendly, the place is as clean and inviting as any small restaurant can be.

This is an amazing place to try if you love great smoked meats!

Its a little shed between Home Depot and a little strip. If you don't know where it is, you might miss it. There isn't much space inside so your best bet is to order then wait in your car. They are quick so it won't be a long wait. The tacos were filled....some places skimp on the meat but these were loaded. They come in regular and supreme. Supreme costs 20 cents more. I also got a chicken burrito for my daughter. The food was well worth it. Meat was perfectly cooked and well seasoned. They give you both the red and green sauces. Having learnt from past experience, I tasted both sauces before putting them on my tacos. If you like spice, go for it. Definitely will be back!

The food was on the salty side, yuca was very hard, beef was very hard as well and didn't taste fresh.  Food was average.  The service was just horrible.  We had a party of 6 adults with 2 kids, the whole restaurant had only one sever working at the time so he naturally couldn't attend us for a while.  We waited for a long time to get our water filled, we had to ask several times for the chips and salsa, and my drink came after the food was brought to me.  I had to remind the waiter a couple of times to get my drink.  The waiter also didn't inform us the price of kids meal, it was $10 for a plate of a little portion of food for kids meal, which I didn't think was worth $10.  He said the drink was about $3.50 then he charged us $3.75.  We asked for chicken to be added to one of the dishes which is additional $3, they didn't add the chicken and still charged $3 on the bill.  One of the vegetarian dishes we ordered costed more on the bill than what was listed in the menu.  The water and chips were never refilled.  At end of an unsatisfactory experience, we were charged 20% gratuity on the bill.  We weren't happy about the service as everything was super slow and we literally were neglected, the waiter made mistakes which caused us to wait even longer for him to go back and correct, we were going to tip less to reflect the unsatisfied experience but in the end we were forced to pay 20%!  Will never go back to this place again.

Sick since Monday, and it's Thursday!
Had shrimp and ended up sick.
Non stop diarrhea. This is not the first time 
I had food delivered, that as terrible.
The pizza and salad was sooo good. And boss even spoke a little Chinese to us, lol, so cute.

Take out experience - 

I stumbled upon Cleavers after watching a YouTube vlogger order from here, trying various cheesesteaks throughout the city. It looked awesome, and I am always down to try a new place, so my girlfriend and I ordered take out before the Eagles game.

The ordering process via phone was simple and quick. Our sandwiches were ready when they said they would be. We got lucky and were able to snag a spot on 18th right across the street. I could see parking being difficult otherwise if picking up take out as it's in a decently busy area. 

After much debating, I ordered a regular cheesesteak with wiz, fried onions, and cherry pepper spread. The meat was top quality ribeye steak perfectly cooked, chopped, and mixed well with the onions and cheese. The seeded roll was a nice added touch, and the bread was perfectly chewy and soft at the same time. My girlfriend ordered porta fresca which absolutely packed with Portobello mushrooms, almost too much for her. But if you're a mushroom fan, this is the sandwich for you. They definitely don't skip on quality and quantity. We also split cheesesteak egg rolls that came with a sriracha aioli. The combo was out of this world and helped me nervously eat myself into a food coma as I watched the Birds pull off the win.

Clever's extensive menu and quality of the sandwiches we ordered will definitely have me coming back again. Looking forward to trying a few more things. Clever's is a must try.

First time trying this restaurant given that we haven't found any great sushi places in Wesley Chapel, or their pieces too small for what they charge.  A little nervous going midweek because of the one bad yelp review, but Tokyo Grill and Sushi did not disappoint!  I was very happy w my sashimi.  Standout pieces included the salmon and eel (just a little crispy on the edge w perfect sauce).  Sashimi deluxe came with spicy tuna roll, which was loaded with fish vs rice.  My boyfriend ordered the fried gyoza and chicken and steak hibachi.  He was very satisfied too.  I tried one gyoza - crispy shell with tasty, soft, not overcooked pork filling inside.  We are so happy to finally find a restaurant by Wesley Chapel, thats not part of a chain, that we can go to regularly and won't break our budget!

Today we went to celebrate my niece's birthday. Our server was Lisa she was amazing. She made as feel comfortable and she was wearing a face mask and gloves the whole time. We had children with us and she did really well with them. Our food was excellent as always but we where so happy with our server she did a great job.
This is the best Mediterranean food!!! You have to eat a bit of everything because it's just all too good. Highly recommend going
We had a wonderful dinner here for my 30th birthday while on vacation in Tucson. We loved eating outside, the service was great, and all parts of our meal were delicious!!

Cute spot. Iced coffees were great. The morning croissy was pretty good. I got a little turned off about halfway thru because of the baked egg but that's just a personal thing (texture issues with food). OH has the tomelette, Swiss and Chive. He said he really liked it. We played a round of galactic on their table top machine while we finished our coffees. Next time I think we'll try it out for dinner.
Worst Father's Day experience for breakfast.  Better food and service at local McDonald's.  Run away!

Wonderful!! In a rarified class all its own. The drinks were perfect and they waited for us to finish our cocktails before the first course-very rare in our experience. Then the appetizers were wonderful as were the main courses (house made pasta with royal reds and the ribs) and the desserts. The service was also impeccable. Can't say enough. If you want to know what all the fuss is about New Orleans and food dine here.

I'm the sister to the reviewer below. This place is so good! I'm a vegetarian who only breaks the rules in the case of good food and in this case, I broke the rules! The bistec was so good! Actually even the onions on top of the steak were good and I believe they may have been pickled. The rice the beans the mofongo were so good and the prices super reasonable. 

It's like an apartment complex or something so it's in a weird spot but man this place is amazing!
Danielle and steve-o gave me the absolute best service i have received in months. I live downtown st pete. We need more energy like this. Xoxoxoxoxoxo

Fun bar, great entertainment, TERRIBLE employees!!!
We were in Nashville Oct 11-14. We were on the roof top on Sunday, not busy at all , three bartenders standing around talking, we called them over 3 times while they laughed and were rude!!! 
Then we went to the main level , friends we were with ordered a top shelve drink and she poured a well drink and charged them for the top shelf. The bartender and her friend sitting at the bar kept staring us down. Employees there are so RUDE!!!!  

Any bar in Nashville - watch your money they all try to rip you off by giving you the wrong change.

The food is always on point  and only downside is how busy they can get. With that said they still provide a great job and there's a reason there always so busy in such a small town. The fajita guacamole salad is tasty and you can never go wrong with the el dorado sampler for your meal. also the draft beer is super cheap
Hands down one of my favorite spots in Nashville!  I could eat here everyday of the week! The food is amazing and drinks are even better.
Always happy to support this place. They've been really on top of orders and do a good, safe job of controlling the crowd

Used to be one of my favorite place to go pho, but recently they increased the price by adding tax but also make the portion smaller. Usually I won't be able to finish the whole pho but now I still feel hungry after eating the whole thing.  The taste is good and the food come out quick.

Updated: I was there 10/26/19 and 11/16/19 during lunch time

Nice staff, but being nice dosen't qualify you for making a good sandwich. Vintage Garden Kitchen's porobello mushroomm sandwich is very subpar. They call it a panini, but its only left in the panini for probably 20 seconds, then served on your paper plate, and you can really tell how old and un-fresh the bread is. The cheese they put on the sandwich really overpowers your pallette and makes it taste like an old stinky cheese sandwich with a few mushrooms. Won't be coming back here; you'll have better luck finding your next tasty meal in the local dumpster
Spaghetti wasn't that good but I'm sure they do better on their pizza I would just make sure the meat is cooked thoroughly next time

The food here is delicious. The shrimp tacos are the bomb!!!! They have very good after hours (happy hour) prices and are located in New Orleans East...close to home. The staff is very friendly and welcoming. It's a good family dinner spot. Don't sleep on them.

Absolutely the worst experience in a restaurant my family has ever had. My adult son rated it the worst pizza he had ever had. Our meal started with dirty water glass. Our bread dishes were both dirty with someone's else's food on them. Waited almost an hour for one pizza. Taste like a frozen pizza. I think the toppings are put on after it's cooked. Spoke to the Manager who didn't seem at all concerned. My wife watch a waiter picked up trash on the floor and never change their gloves. Please support other restaurant that deserve your money. I didn't feel the management care if I spent my time in the hospital from COVID 19. Please have a safe night and take these negative reviews seriously I wish I did.
Love this place! They have always had amazing food. From in store to food delivery, they are great. The staff is great and their service is impeccable.

Took an afternoon drive out to Santa Barbara. After viewing Destination LA I spotted KanaloaSeafood on their Sunday program. We decided to give them a try. 
Not disappointed!
Fresh fish tacos
Delicious calamari 
Fresh Shrimp Ceviche 
Scrumptious Ahi Poki Bowl
Plenty of outdoor seating.
It was a beautiful day so it made the outdoor eating 
Much more pleasurable.
Street parking
And Parking structure across the street 
Expansive menu
Will return!
The margaritas were not good and my food was cold. Super overpriced for no service. Was not a good experience for a first time visit.
Exceptional service and delicious food! My fave was the Garganelli Verde, Heritage Pork Ragout, Sarvecchio.
very good. everything was so tasty. waiter was very informative. just wished they served daquiri's! outdoor seating was weather permitting and I would return

Walked by this place several times but recently on a whim my friend and I decided to give it a try. The Red Lion is a solid pub type place. Good beer on draft and good pub atmosphere. That's enough for a 4 star review from me. But why 5 stars? Why?! The *best* fish and chips in the city! That's why!! Honestly I will go here again just for the fish and chips. Many places under-season the fish, but not at the Red Lion. It was soooo flavorful. And cooked well.  And just... you have to try it. Mmmmm....
Delicious food! Great service! Fried eggplant, shrimp poboy, shrimp n grits were all so good!
Good coffee, pastries tend to be on the dry side. Low rating because entire staff on hand was not wearing masks. Pandemic isn't over just because you're over it.

This place is ridiculously good. There is something for everyone. There are so many options to choose from. The line can get very busy so I recommend getting in line early. Prices are reasonable considering you're inside a casino. If you don't have a players card, GET ONE! You'll save some $$$ when eating. They also have a military discount for those military individuals and their families. GOTTA CHECK IT OUT!

Food was fresh. Loved that they offered "buffet" style side "condiments" (garlic, pepperchinis, pickles, etc.). Ordered shrimp po boy and corn/clam chowder. Shrimp were not deveined. Ahh!!! Not sure why restaurants do that in 2019! Loved it until I saw that unsightly vein staring back at me. Would go back and try something else. Besides the dirty shrimp, the food was great.

First Watch is standard good. The food is classically delicious and will not disappoint. I have not had a negative experience at First Watch. 

Today my eating companion and I enjoyed the Hash Skillet - Farmhouse and Eggs Benedict. The Hash Skillet included - scrambled eggs (your choice), sun dried tomatoes, avocado, bacon, potatoes, and sautéed onions. It was a medley of flavors that worked well together - although the sun dried tomatoes were a bit sweet. The plate also included toast, strawberry preserve, and a fruit cup. 

The Eggs Benedict was really good, I chose the classic option which included the poached eggs, ham, tomato, and a delicious hollandaise sauce. The hollandaise was light but flavorful - really, really good. There was lots of ham - so I opted to take some off. The meal came with a generous side of fruit which one could choose the fruit types to include. The only negative to the  meal was that it was oddly cold - I didn't complain about it though. 

Neither breakfast was roll-you-out of the restaurant huge, it was literally a perfect amount of food. 

I will be back to First Watch!

I have ate here multiple times and have always had nothing but top notch service and even better food. Haven't ever ordered take-out so was curious how it would turn out and if it still held up to the standards of dining inside...and let me tell you, it was just as amazing! Pulled right up, waited 3 minutes, made it home and food was still at the perfect temperature!

I have the uppermost empathy for businesses trying to survive during this mess. And so, for the third time in 3 months, we tried The Trappe. Terrific food on the first trip, nice outdoor setup. Same setting and selection, inferior food on the second. Third try, on a lovely Sunday holiday summer's night. 

You know what they say about first impressions? Well, its mid-Monday and we are both still steamed about the start of the dining "experience."  Were it not for the presence of my friend, I would have (and should have) turned and walked out. The hostess (a misnomer in this case) - even with her mask on - it was instantly obvious she was annoyed upon our arrival at her podium. No greeting, just a curt "Inside or out?" without any eye contact. "Um, out (I said) if there's a good table." (Take note of my qualifier.)  She shuffled about 6 steps to her left,  swung open the door to the deck - pointed to a small lonely high top dead ahead, and said "that one there."  Remember my request. It clearly had not penetrated the mask.  The table was sitting mid-stream of all traffic: waitresses, busboys, bathroom travelers, etc.  Quick scan by the paying customer - me - and "how about that table to the left over there?" I asked (where a young man was cleaning a larger table nestled up against the wall to our left. Nice view, private, reduced  chance of getting sideswiped.  Here it comes.  MAJOR roll of the eyes (emphasized by the aforementioned  mask.) It gets better.  Equally huge heave o

The food was great, and our server was incredible,  unfortunately the restrictions for COVID were only enforced for some patrons.  Had a table of 6 seated close enough that I could reach over and touch them had I chosen to (a little over 3ft). The first group of 6 that had been seated there must've felt the same way were did because they asked to be seated somewhere else after sitting down and looking at how close they were to everyone that was already there.   Then a second group was seated at the same table 3 feet away from ours moments later without the least bit of cleaning having been done.  Some of the patrons were also walking around from table to table without masks visiting with people they knew including the table 3ft from ours.  At one point they had wedged themselves between our table and the one they were visiting.  This would've been an issue under normal circumstances but now just seems even more ridiculous.  Our server took notice of everything and even asked once for the people to  move away from the other tables and return to their original table but was ignored.  She offered to bring the manager to handle it and speak with us but when she informed the manager he walked into the dining area, saw what was going on and just sat down at a table on the other side of the room,  never addressing the customer wandering through the dining area without a face covering touching anything he walked past.  When my family member asked a second time to voice his concern to

Came here because of the Yelp elite event and ended up taking some donuts home so I could snap a few delicious pictures for a client. 
The best part of this donut shop is definitely the location, right in downtown and the views from their store make you want to stay and hang out. I got a Boston cream donut and it was pretty good, not my fave for donuts but the only local place I've tried so far. I think the donuts may be Vegan... not sure but they were definitely really sweet. I also took home some other flavors and my husband said he loved them.

I stopped I for lunch after a friend told me it was good. But I wasn't very impressed with this place. The steak Burrito bowl was a little on the small side and was kind of bland. I'm not a big fan of chipotle sauce but had to use it to give it some type of flavor. I feel like this place is trying to be like Qdoba or Chipotle but a lesser quality. There are much better food places in the area.

Alex was our server that was the high point of the night
We started with the Poke
 my wife got the fish and chips
They overcooked the fish of course.

I got the Tavern burger, medium it was good 
it was during happy hour beer prices are great, get the Coriander

There was a slight lady standing curbside during the coved-19 crisis. I was hungry and never had eaten there before. I thought a salad, noodles and bread covered in Carmel, how special could it be?

Boy, I am impressed. The greens were so beautiful they seemed to be of baby roses to look at but, to taste I do not even know what the greens were. My only words, fantastic!

The noodles were done al dente with fresh baked bread.
An amazing meal rounded out by a substitute dessert of Eclat chocolate.
Four stars all the way around!
Boy, shop small, shop local.... amen!

I usually come here to get their fruit bubble teas because they are one of the few boba places in the city that uses fresh fruit. Super delicious and refreshing! I finally decided to give their food a try. I had the vermicelli with grilled shrimp and pork. My girlfriend had the wonton soup. I enjoyed my vermicelli. The wonton soup was a little sweet for her but she said it was still good. Decent price and good portions. Staff was very nice and helpful. Definitely recommend.

Very yummy. Plantains were fat and juicy! Mac was banging! Saffron rice hit and idk how y'all made those drumsticks, but they made me very happy.

I think I ordered wrong and got all sides, which made my order over $55. There must be a more cost efficient option that I overlooked. If not, then I'll only be able to dine here infrequently. 

Anyways, thank you for feeding me!
Wings were great but their sammys were just okay. A little bit pricy but not crazy. Service was on the slower expected.  Wings were 9.9/10 hands down.

It's fine. Steak fries limitless and pop is bottomless, as advertised but it offers just few other burgers an not much else for salads or soup options. It's clean & staff seem very pleasant.   Tower of onions were 5 on the side for 2.50 +tax!!!

I love the PDQ on Dale Mabry, I go there all the time and always have wonderful experiences each time, no matter the time of day. Even at 9:59PM, Sorry  but it's so good any time of day. They deserve 5 stars for always having amazing customer service and getting my order right each time I'm there. This review is more for the PDQ on Linebaugh Ave. I've only been there twice but each time it's been a negative experience. The first time I went they messed up my order, don't remember exactly how because it was months ago but I went there today, as I was in the area and this was the PDQ available. I proceeded to order a Buffy Blu, without lettuce, which it would say on my receipt, but when I got home it had a large amount of lettuce on it. Okay, not the end of the world, obviously I can take off the lettuce, but while I was in the restaurant ordering the young lady behind the counter asked me if I wanted any sauces with my zucchini fries, in which I replied yes, Buffy blu please. When I received the bag there was no sauce. I waited up at the front for a minute or two until the girl who gave me my food asked, what I needed, but that wasn't until after she greeted someone else, seeming to be her friend. Usually each PdQ I visit, the people are dedicated to quality, but this didn't seem to be the case. Disappointing, and I probably won't come back to the PDQ on Linebaugh Ave, but I still love PDQ, especially the one on Dale Mabry.
I grab veggie burrito bowl, there were no veggies left still they charge full amount. They don't deserve a single start but I can't give less than that to provide feedback here.

Enjoyable atmosphere.  Great food.  Exceptional service.  The octopus was perfectly grilled.  The cheese saganaki, wonderful.  Grilled Meat Selection for Two - chicken, pork, and lamb meats grilled, with two sides, pita bread, and tzatziki, is our go-to entrée.  And, they deliver...on time!
Love this place, the owner is so great & shes super sweet to my kids. Ice cream is so good...will come back again & again.

I continue to support restaurants owned and run by immigrants during the Covid-19 crisis.  They have received no government monies or loans during this pandemic and many have had to close being unable to pay rents. A few of us recently did a takeout from Mount Masala in Voorhees, NJ.  This is a Nepalese owned restaurant which advertises Himalayan food.  In Vienna, I have a favorite Nepalese restaurant a short walk from my apartment so I was eager to try out Mount Masala.

The ordering and pick-up went smoothly and we took our feast with us to enjoy.  There sure was a lot of food!  Now the not-as-good news is that I did not find the food as compelling and tasty as my wonderful Nepalese restaurant in Vienna.  Indeed a couple of Tibetan restaurants I patronize also have more delicious food.  But there were some tasty items.  The steamed chicken momos were well prepared and that is very important in a Nepalese eatery.  The sizzling chicken momos came with a sauce that was interesting but prob something I wouldn't do again.  The lollipop chicken was worth ordering and came with a nice dipping sauce.  Now the entrees were a mixed bag for me.  The best was the Himalayan chicken with some interesting spices and flavors running through this dish.  The shrimp skinny noodles had very, very little shrimp and not a lot of taste.  And I didn't care much for the beef kala bhatmas.  There was too little beef and too much sauce .... and that sauce needed more spice and heat which I had reques

First and last  time we will be dining here. Manicotti was so drowned in sauce that we couldn't even see them. The Veal Parm was so tough and over cooked that we could hardly cut it, let alone chew it, and flavor didn't taste like veal. Salad entree my sister had was so overdressed and overly sweet that it ruined an otherwise healthy dish.  The Kick'n Corn  and Crab soup was mediocre at best, and could have used some salt and sugar to sweeten the corn. The  salad  that came with our entrees was ok.  I am not a fan of iceberg lettuce though, and the presentation in a cheap plastic bowl was also unfitting to the ambiance, which I thought was quite swank upon our entrance, so I was impressed  at first . That is why we were so disappointed by our meal. We really thought we were in for a really nice meal in a really nice place.  The server was pleasant, but I was left without a beverage when our entrees came  and was never offered a soft drink or water when I mentioned I was a designated driver after finished my one cocktail. Although the server adjusted the bill for the veal entree, it couldn't make up for the poor meal.  Thank goodness we were in good company with each other, we still  didn't let the meal ruin our good time.

I come almost twice a week for lunch. Can't go wrong with a quick and delicious burrito. Price is very good considering how much food they manage to pack in a single tortilla. I mentioned how some of the lights were out and this week I went in and they were all swapped out. Cheers to the wonderful service!
One of, if not, the best delis in St. Louis! Great meat, cheese, and bread choices that are always fresh. All the employees are awesome. Overall a great place to eat!

This restaurant is operating poorly. The food is good but this time I witnessed something disgusting that has made me stop eating here. When I walked into this restaurant, I witnessed the cook not wearing a mask while handling food during a PANDEMIC. He also was not wearing gloves. To make things even worse, he coughed and wiped his nose then grabbed lettuce and put it on a sandwich without washing his hands. This is absolutely nasty. The other workers had on a mask, but wore it under their chin. They are not covering their nose or mouths. When I told them why I did not want my food her response was "The health inspector came yesterday and said we weren't sick". Health inspectors do not give people medical tests. I would not recommend anyone eat here especially in the middle of a pandemic.
Favorite Ramen place! So so good!!! Can be a little pricey but worth it for quality ramen

Was kinda not expecting this place to be in a hotel but ok , they offered valet which was for free which was nice! The place was cute ! They had a cactus Christmas tree , loud atmosphere everyone was into the tequila trees , but enjoyable . Started off with a spicy margarita which was phenomenal , and had the blue crab street corn which wasn't as great as I thought , which it seems to be a very popular choice , also we got the nacho which was really
Good and the portion was pretty big my Husband didn't like that it came in a metal pan because he said he could taste the metal in some of the bites of his food . For our entrees we got the pecan crusted carnitas, the brisket enchiladas, and brisket tamales , was looking to get the duck empanadas but they weren't on the menu , portions were small but most entree came with rice and beans. And the food was delish I enjoyed it all

Visited Condado Mass Ave for brunch on a Sunday.  There was no wait, and me and my girlfriend were sat immediately.  Eli was our waiter - he was awesome!  We had guacamole and roja salsa, both were fantastic.  My girlfriends tacos came out incorrect - and had to be remade.  It seems as if when they were remade, they rushed to get them remade (which we appreciated) but the rice was undercooked in the process.  All in all, I have way more positive experiences here than I do bad, and will be back soon!

Lol this place is just terrible. I went here for the first time as a DoorDasher and my experience could not have been worse. First, I had to place the order myself (normally the order is already placed and the dasher just picks it up). Fine, not a big deal. I then waited for 45 minutes for my food, during which I got to see how nasty the owner/manager of this place is. He was yelling at his employees, delivery drivers, and even customers, hanging up on a few of them over the phone. He also had his mask below his nose and was frantically throwing delivery bags on the ground while preparing orders, which is not only disgusting but a major food safety issue. I feel sorry for anyone who has to put up with his disgusting attitude. If you can't handle the stress of a fast-paced environment, maybe you shouldn't be the manager of a pizza place working on a Friday night. The employees at the front desk didn't seem to care about any of the customers, but I honestly can't blame them because if I worked in that dump I wouldn't care either. I was given the wrong order about halfway through my 45 minute wait. Finally got my order and when I dropped it off, the customer told me the order was wrong. I called back, and after being passed between four different people who all asked the same question and offered no solution, I finally spoke to the man-child in charge, and he blamed me instead of owning up to the mistake and giving the customer what they actually paid for.

We were staying at the JW Marriott so we masked up and headed down to High Velocity hotel bar for some drinks and an appetizer.  Limited bourbon selection but Four Roses Small Batch Select (neat) saved the day!  My date had a soft drink or as we say in Indiana, "a pop".  Pretzel appetizer was just ok and forgettable. This has been another COVID-19 pandemic review.
The problem is that they have not open the dinning room for they don't trust in the Lord and fear is greater.

Cute shop and honestly a fantastic drip coffee. If a shop can do something as basic as a drip coffee you know that's a testament.

It's also a cute spot from what I could see to stop in and do some work on your laptop. Seemed like 90% of the people there that day were doing just that.

Rarely go here from past experiences here. Said why not, my children like it. It was pretty empty and the hostess took us to a booth that was loaded with dirty dishes, so table it is no biggie. Took awhile to get a server, she was very nice thought. Ordered a beer, out of it. Ordered 2 more and out of those. So went for a basic and luckily had that. Ordered 3 starters and a salad. That took 45 mins and salty was an understatement. The bbq chicken salad was a dismal display and bbq was slightly poured over the chicken. However it was tasty. The dirty tables stayed dirty the 1 1:2 hrs we were there even as a manager walked by 2x. On a good note though, I got to spend some great time with my children and I'll take slow food any day for that.

We don't have Peet's nearby, back home, so I decided to Yelp and check for one here. To my surprise this place was 1/2 a mile from where we we are staying. So you know we had to check it out. My vanilla latte was good but not good as usual. The coffee taste was a little bitter. I'll for sure be stopping by tomo morning tho. Peet's is for sure, hands down, my choice for a coffee place.
Great authentic food to eat in or take home and make yourself. Big portions and fast service. A little pricy, but most of the ingredients come from Italy so you get what you pay for and it's amazing

Was able to walk in around 8pm without a reservation and got seated right away. Service was quick and friendly! Ordered the passion fruit mojito which was delicious! For an appetizer we got the Buffalo blasts. Was surprised when they came out looking like chicken tenders but they were very crunchy and actually stuffed with Buffalo chicken. Unfortunately, we devoured them before taking a photo! For dinner I got the truffle honey chicken, large portions and the chicken was perfectly fried but the flavor was very bland and dry for both the chicken and potatoes.

Environment was very pretty for a modest priced menu. Although I was a little lost on where to start on the menu, but I am a bit picky so most things just did not catch my eye. I ended up ordering the double dragon roll and it was very good. I usually indulge in big meals but I was quite satisfied with the size of roll and even had a couple pieces left. I tried sake for the first time and was really impressed. It was very light and almost refreshing to sip with my dinner.  All in all it was a good small meal to end my day, my only complaint would be my server seemed to never hear me right multiple times through my meal.
Caldo de res is good but they need to cut there carrots down but over all good food nice and clean spot

I've driven by this place for years.  So glad I finally decided to try it.  It's small and the parking is tricky but the food is amazing!!  We tasted each other's dishes and Loved every bite we tried.  Tiramisu and lemon marscapone cake are light and at the same time flavorful.  Just the right about of sweetness. Delicious overall!!

I tried to get in here twice while staying at hotel next door.  Its extremely popular, which should say a lot.  I ordered takeout so as not to be denied a second time.  The spring rolls were creations more robust than any I've had before.  The pho was delicious as I expected for such large crowds.  My only regret was there was not more indoor seating, but I'll probably be back anyway.

A great place with food to match.  Not as good as it gets but real close.  

Go and enjoy.  They have the heart and soul of a venue with visiting

Placed a pick up order at BJ's Brewhouse and when we got it home, realized they left out the desert. Sat down to eat and my phone rang. It was BJ's saying they were sorry they forgot it and are sending me a gift card to get it at a later date so I don't have to come back. Although, my meat wasn't cooked as I requested, I'm very impressed that they were proactive and I didn't even have a chance to call. Good job BJ's!

The sushi here is good and the service is good. I caught them early for dinner service on a Friday and found out after I arrived it wasn't an AYCE sushi place after I arrived. The place showed up as AYCE sushi  on Google, but it wasn't. The parking lot is tiny. The place is pretty plain. Good experience and food overall.

Yo this place is da bomb‼ just got it this morning and I'm going back for lunch, cha feel? Like it really be dat good n shit. They cook them bagels mad fuxin good. Like on sum real shit it be da best breakfast sandwich I ever done had‼‼‼‼

This bar was great with Covid restrictions and quite possibly the best cocktails I've had! They're smaller drinks, but the alcohol is so good, definitely a more elegant feel than most bar drinks. The atmosphere is very speakeasy type and the aesthetic was pleasing. Our waitress was sweet and attentive. Totally recommend.

Monell's is a must!  This a snapshot of southern style dining. It's as much a feeling of lifestyle & tradition as is it restaurant. The food is served family-style and you will be sharing with the table, but there is more than enough to satisfy. We had a late breakfast so we got to see lunch being served around us and both looked awesome. For my personal preference, breakfast is the better option.  There were sweet rolls and biscuits with gravy & peach preserves to begin the meal and one would be tempted to fill up on bread alone. But please, I beg you, wait for the bounty that follows. We were served a meat basket featuring bacon, sausage & ham and much to my surprise, the ham stood out. It was glazed with red eye gravy and tasted very good. They also served potatoes, pancakes, scrambled eggs & southern fried apples, and that would be waaay more than enough. But the cheese grits & corn pudding sent this breakfast over the top. Oh, and FRIED CHICKEN...  FOR BREAKFAST!  Apparently the fried chicken is served with every meal. I'm certain that lunch & dinner are amazing but I was so impressed with breakfast that we will be certainly be back Saturday morning for brunch. With the permanent closing of Two Sisters in Jackson, Mississippi, Monell's is up for nomination for the defining dining experience of the south.
Our new go-to sushi place. Coming from LA I'm pretty picky when it comes to my sushi & this place gives me my fix. It's very fresh and has a great variety of dishes.

They've been going downhill for a while. Tell you 30 minute when placing your order but actually aren't ready till 30 minutes after the time they gave you. Well today I show up, 5 minutes after the time they gave me and they had sold my sandwich to someone else. I'll never go back and I'll never recommend them to another person.

I am such a huge Baileys Range fan, been here so many times and finally writing a review. Every burger I've tried is so tasty... the PB and J and Ozark are my faves, but tried the K Pop last night (Korean flavors with kimchi on top)... it was so unique and tasty. Love their fries too, and can't go wrong with their chocolate milkshake. Always a hit wi5h me, love this place

I am quite the fan of Cuban food and duck into any and every Cuban restaurant I can.    Arco Iris Cafe was on my way to an event so I popped in for cafe con leche and tostada.   This review is based on those two items and nothing more.   Arco Iris may have the best vaca frita, ropa vieja, roast pork, maduros... (fill in your favorite dish)... ever.  I just did not get to try it at 9 in the morning.

Arco Iris is a nice, clean restaurant with a couple of tv screens; a full parking lot and tables filled with spanish-speaking people.   I ordered my cafe con leche and tostada at the counter and then decided to eat it there.  

CCL comes in small, medium and large.  I went with a medium.  It was hot and sweet. I would have appreciated another shot of cafe cubano but I happen to like my CCL strong!   The tostada was a disappointment.   It was a good size.. probably 10 inches of bread.. and it had the right amount of butter (you could taste it but it did not drip or leave stains on the paper).  Unfortunately, it had not been pressed long enough or hard enough.   I prefer my tostada to be.. well.. toasted.   That means the bread's exterior is crisp and the pieces are thin enough to easily dunk in my CCL without dripping cafe everywhere.   Le Segunda is my standard.  Perfectly pressed tostada even if the Segunda order is kind of small.

I would definitely try Arco Iris again and ask them to toast the bread longer.. or better yet, come back for lunch or dinner to try one of the offerin
Very very good service food was amazing and dessert was even better and super cheap prices
So yummy. We love coming here with the kids. They take the Axxess card too. Their lunch menu is affordable and is really big

This place is a hidden gem!! The Thai Chicken Wings are some of the best wings I've ever had!! They're so full of flavor and the onions and peppers just add to it! The sticky rice is good too! I wish I could give this place more than five stars because it was perfect! The prices are reasonable, the service was great, the food is delicious. I can't wait to try their whole menu. Lol

This is a great value authentic taqueria with a wide variety of dishes. And they offer legit Mexican food. The service was a bit slow the night we went. But we weren't in a rush.

I ordered the Torta Milanesa de Pollo. It's a gargantuan sandwich with tons of avocado, queso fresco, and fried breaded chicken on a Kaiser roll.

All the contents were fresh and the whole thing had a great balance of crunch, proteins, and fats. 4 stars not 5 because nothing about it blew me away. But this was a great torta.

Had an amazing time here today with my mother t celebrate her birthday. The toucans sweatheart was amazing and the $3 spiked seltzer was a steal! Definitely recommend the rocket feller oysters with bacon and spinach! our server was very attentive and knowledgeable on the menu...Would definitely come back again.

I was pleasantly surprised by this smartly decorated bistro just off the lobby of our New Orleans lodgings, The Old #77 Hotel and Chandlery (Google it).  We grabbed a bite there as merely an after thought before having to kill 4 hours before our flight.  (HEY HOTEL OWNERS, I WOULD HAVE PAID AS MUCH AS I PAID FOR MY ENTIRE STAY HAD YOU LET ME STAY JUST 4 MORE HOURS - CAN WE PLEASE LET PEOPLE CHECK OUT WHEN THEY WANT TO CHECK OUT!).  I digress.  

Our server Kim was on point with what appeared to be a carefully curated farm to market menu.  She went into meticulous detail on the different selections until Orlando finally settled in the snapper and I went with the burger.  A restaurant is only as good as it's cheeseburger.  I also ordered this brocolli cashew side, which when it arrived I though for sure it was spinach.  That's when Kim took me to school and on the anatomy of the broccoli plant.  (I believe it still may have been spinach, but no matter it was delicious and I was convinced). 

The food, mixed with a breezy CSNY-Ish play list and the stunning decor made the slightly higher than average prices well worth it.  

Although it's easy enough to cross the line at this price point, it didn't feel pretensious but only very warm. 

The hostess even charged my phone for me while we were eating.  

Nicely done.  I'll be back.

love y'all thx, I have to keep writing Bc apparently the review is too short for yelp but yeah, it's awesome to have vegan food become more accessible the foods pretty filling which as a vegan is awesome and the prices are decent/worth what yr paying for

Amazing sushi, easily the best in the area. 

Despite what others may have written the service is very attentive. The owners are always at the restaurant working so it's obviously in their best interest to make sure everyone is taken care of. 

The restaurant itself is very cozy and nice, and there is an outdoor seating area as well. 

Out of the dozen or so highly rated sushi restaurants in the Tampa bay we have been to, Hot Sake is definitely our new favorite!

The red beans here are awesome. I used to eat them once a week almost when I was too lazy to cook! The service has always been terrible but I put up with it because the poboys and red beans were good. Now though they've gotten rid of French fries as a side which seems a bit ridiculous for a POBOY SHOP! Not worth the service any more since I'm not a big fan of the other side.

We were in the area and looking for a place to grab dinner. Found the Pour House on Yelp so figured we try it out. Parking lot was full but wait for a table was about 10-15 minutes, so not too bad.

Our server was very attentive and came around to check on us often. My grandmother and I ordered fish and chips (she got butternut squash instead of potato wedges) The fish and Chips was a generous portion size but the potato wedges were forgettable; they didn't have much flavor besides pepper. The fish batter also had a bit of a kick. My sister enjoyed her salad as well.

They also run promotions throughout the week; I think Wednesdays had an Oyster Special of some sort.

Love the app that I can order my food and then just drive through the drive-through and get it. Employees are very friendly and courteous and helpful in any type of way. Condiments are always full, always asking if you need a drink refill or anything else and it's always their pleasure

Its okay. Carb ragoon was good. The Mongolian beef was mostly onion. The fried rice is plan. Nothing fancy. Wouldnt go again. The place looks ran down, and there was some beggars that
Got me For A Dollar for more
Food

Excellent food at reasonable prices.  The pork and cheese sub was excellent and the Reuben, on fresh-baked rye, was a thing of beauty.  Very good fries (at least when you specify crispy) and the cole slaw was just right.  Very highly recommended.
Great selection. We were able to get Yellow Edge Grouper freshly cut. Just make sure your friends know how to prepare it.

Stumbled across this place while driving around Indy. I walk in and immediately see the menu which reads, "Breakfast Served All Day".  I love it when menus talk dirty to me. Unfortunately, almost all of their breakfast headliners were sold out. A little depressing, but also a good sign. So I asked the friendly cashier for help, and she directs me to the Pulled Chicken Hot Brown with a Duck Egg. "It's a thick piece of toast with the middle scooped out for the filling" she says. What arrives later at my table appears to be a perfectly toasted quarter loaf of bread with melted cheese and an over easy duck egg on top.  The inside had indeed been scooped out, and was filled with tender pulled chicken, a few jalapeño slices, and spicy brown gravy. Soooooo good.......I'm pretty sure I am going to dream about it tonight. I have now rearranged my life goals, and at the top of the list is making it to this place early one day before the breakfast is sold out. Love Handle is fresh and original, just like your old pal Randy.
If I could leave 0 stars I would. Staff on Saturday at 1pm were RUDE AND LAZY. Food was horrific. Terrible place and should close.  Terrible terrible terrible.

I had flown to Philly and looked up cheesesteaks and this place was one of the first places that popped up and it seemed like the best option so we decided to give it a try. It is cash only so luckily there was an ATM across the street or we would've been screwed. We probably waited about 20-30 minutes to place our order which wasn't too bad considering how long the line was. I ordered the cheesesteak whiz which had the traditional cheese, steak and onions whole my friend got the cheesesteak with provolone cheese. I would recommend the whiz because when it's just the provolone the sandwich is pretty dry, so the warm cheese on the whiz really gives it moisture. I really like the grilled onions on the sandwich because they were perfectly crunchy and still had a lot of flavor. My sandwich was overall pretty good, just didn't really defy any expectations or was overtly fantastic. I guess I might have just had higher expectations?

Love this place. It's location is great for me since it's close to the hospital. I've tried breakfast and other meals from this place. The 50/50 is an egg sandwich with bacon mixed in. The Hawaiian bun adds just a touch of sweetness. The egg is super soft. It's not a greasy sandwich at all. The chicken sandwiches are fantastic. Great crisp, juicy chicken, and not greasy at all. My favorite is the habanero. The fries mixed with fried onions are a guilty pleasure of mine. The onion adds a change to the texture and some sweetness to traditional fries. Fried pickles were okay for me. Not my favorite, but not bad. Definitely a go to spot for me.

I walked in here shortly after they opened. There was a man behind the bar cleaning up. I stood there for a minute before asking for a miller lite. He responded very curtly how he isn't the bartender, the bartender is late as hell, he can't use the register, he can't help me. Then he walked away. I understand he is frustrated that his coworker is late but there is no reason to take it out on me. I would fire this dick before he costs you more customers.

A really good place with a really good food, I think portions were really good. I went during an elite event week and tried their new burrito which is the queso crunch burrito and tried it with beef. It was really good, highly recommend it and will definitely come back to get more food. The only thing is I don't like onions in my food and when I asked for the ingredients for one of the things inside the burrito I was told it doesn't have onions and it did. It was a lot of it too and I had to take them out one by one! Just that but everything else was outstanding. I highly recommend trying then strawberry lemonade!! Too good!

We like local places and seek them out. Breakfast our favorite meal.
We found this spot accidently..
a part of town we don't usually see
Ordered eggs scrambled w/ sausage patty & toast w/ home fries. Eggs were ok/ avg. home fries are just chopped potatoes lightly browned and tasteless. Had a couple bites of sausage.
.got colder approaching the center...waitress offered to get me another, then quickly came back and took it back to " warm it up"
A bite of the reheated sausage on a hot plate revealed that microwaving had vulcanized subject sausage. Disappointing experience
It's the best Thai food in Tucson. The pineapple fried rice and pad thai are spectacular and I love the peanut sauce and pad see ew as well. Very good prices too.

EAT SOMEWHERE ELSE. As a local this was the worst behavior I have ever witnessed. The food took forever, the staff was rude. We got buzzed in, and then dryly told us, "wrong number" then we had to stand in line since the buzzer had already been set off, we waited 45 minutes for two Cuban sandwiches, and they didn't even apologize for the wait. Horrible experience and will never visit again. 


Go somewhere else if you want respectable food and service.

We had the shrimp poboy, a shrimp/oyster poboy and onion rings.  The food was really good, had to wait about 15 minutes for it to come out, just enough time for a beer.

The server was really nice and was fairly attentive.  I would recommend this place.

Food was alright, however felt like it was very unseasoned. The meat and beans especially. The guacamole also was very bland. Overall, could use some more spices! 
Loved the atmosphere! Waitress was super kind!

Great food at a reasonable price! 

Ate there twice while staying nearby. Beautiful place to watch the sun go down. 

I must say the food presentation was much better in the morning then at night. 

Rum Runner Bucket was a great deal I shared it with me sis! drink was great taste just like a Mai Tai! 

They have renamed a few of my favorites actually. Did not have one bad thing! Great place I truly suggest it.

Great shrimp skillet! It's hard to find non-dairy, pescatarian options for breakfast and this was filling and delicious. Kids loved the French toast and the generous helping of fruit that came with it. We ordered takeout and it still tasted fresh.
Honestly not a great Starbucks. Every drink here feels half assed over the last couple years. I always feel like I wasted my money when I come to this location :( Robb drive Starbucks is better.

Everything about this experience was exceptional. From calling to make a reservation, to sitting for dinner, the guest services team was pleasant, full of energy, engaging, accommodating, and attentive. 

We sat outside (of course) on their beautiful, oasis style patio, decorated with full greenery and string lights. Simple accents like this take you away from the city. The food was delectable, so delectable that I ordered a second of the same plate after finishing the first (can't remember the name of the dish, but it was a fish). The flavors were robustly, but delicately blended. The fish was perfectly seared, retaining its tenderness with just the right amount of crisp. You know it was good if I can remember it a month or more later! Even the drinks had complex profiles that seduced my palette!

Next time I'm in Philly, I WILL be back! Kudos to you, Harpers Garden.
This is my favorite spot in & around upper darby! I never get the same thing! Every time I order, i'm never disappointed

Adorable atmosphere, very family friendly environment. Prices are reasonable for the portions that you get with the menu. Had the shiitake tofu lettuce wrap and banana bread pudding when I was here. The tofu had a good amount of spice; it's different with  a modern take! The pudding was warm and the icream added a nice touch to satisfy any sweet tootth. The chef said they don't often serve dessert, so when they have it grab it when you can!

My first time trying this restaurant and it is a fantastic spot. The vegetarian dishes were outstanding especially the roasted cauliflower!! The servers were so helpful and nice. I can't wait to make another visit!
Really good food and it is very affordable. My cons are: Soulard location is kind of small and the menu is rather limited but the food they do offer is delicious.

I came here for dinner with a friend and we ordered the drunken noodles and pad Thai with tofu. The spices and noodles were cooked very well! Service was good though a little bit overbearing. I would come here again but it was a bit pricey. The bill ended up being around $40 after tip.

Came in with a large group & received frustrating service by the manager when we asked for the couple orders of fries we were missing. Have never been to a fast food restaurant that made such a big deal out of completing an order and then making it seem like we were trying to cheat them out of maybe $7 worth of food when our order was worth well over $100.
Soo good! Food is delicious and the portions are large with reasonable prices. Will definitely go again!

For us, Daddy Dawgs checked all of our boxes for an amazing hot dog joint!  They even offer 3 different hot dog brands, that are proper for the specific region and style:  Vienna Beef for a Chicago dog, Sabrett for a NY style, and Nathan's for a Coney.  Wow, I seldom see this!  That is going above and beyond and definitely gives DD a sort of serious hot dog "pedigree."  Family owned and operated, we received very friendly and Covid safe service here.  They even offered free ice cream samples, which of course resulted in us buying and enjoying some!  We very much look forward to coming back...
Awesome food! Service was a little slower and server wasn't thrilled to be there, but the food was awesome and would definitely go back for the food!

When they get it right, it's great! But after getting the same sandwich twice in one week with totally different results, I decided to do a little experiment. I continued to order that same sandwich (with the same customizations) for several more days: in-store, online for pick-up and online for delivery. The ONE time the order was right, the sandwich was delicious and perfect. All of the other times, the issues were one or many of the following:
-no sauce on the side as requested
-a different sauce requested to be eliminated entirely was applied in excess to the point of almost being inedible
-requested normal amount of cheese and got zero cheese
-requested normal amount of tomatoes and got just one small slice on each side
-this sandwich is heated up and always the cheese is half hanging off of the bread

I went to the Panera yesterday in Wayne and had zero issues. That will be my new location from now on.

Having gone to try this place because it just opened not too long ago, I have to say, it was pretty good. This place has all the BBQ classics. Ribs, sausage, brisket, pulled pork, smoked turkey. They have it all. They also have all the classic BBQ side dishes. Mac n Cheese, collard greens, French fries, baked beans. I thought overall, the flavors were pretty solid. The brisket was pretty moist, with a very nice tender texture. Not to the point where it disintegrates but rather it is able to hold it's meaty form but is still pull apart tender. The sausage had a nice snappy texture to it and pairs well with the mustard based barbeque sauce. As for the sides, the Mac n Cheese was nice and creamy and the collard greens were stewed well with smoked ham providing a nice smokey flavor in the background. I think the only thing I wish was "better" if you can call it that was I wish the portion sizes were a tad bit bigger. While I left satisfied with the food, I also left wanting for more. I think this is a good addition to the food scene in Largo and look forward to coming back again :)

The best tacos, tortas, and tortillas!!! Their ingredients are always fresh, the staff is always friendly. We eat here at least once a week because it's that good. They have a small, basic menu. But it all so good, we don't get bored.

Love this place while I visit St Louis for work.  All pastas, bread, food is made in house.  No frozen foods here!  I always get the fried risotto balls.  Creamy rice goodness served with marinara and an herb Aoli.  Divine!  Chopped salad was a breath a fresh air in a city of iceberg and provel cheese.  Stroppezetti pasta with a bologna sauce.  Large filling portion of al dents fresh pasta and a thick meat sauce.  Enough to share. Dessert was the lightest fluffiest version of Tiramisu I've ever had.
It was perfection.

While traveling through the area, my wife and I stumbled across Nocella's in Haddonfield.  I just can't say enough about how great the food and service was.  Our meal could just be one of the best meals we've ever had.  I had the linguini Fra Diavoli and my wife had Eggplant parmigiana. You will not be hungry or disappointed when you leave this fine establishment.  We will be back at Nocella's when we visit the area again.
What a cool place to hang out. Great music, great good and the coldest beer in town! Outside is the place to be for sure but inside is nice as well.
They have never messed up anything and it's honestly some of the best food in general around. Good stuff.

Yeah, I know that "over the top" is the thing they are going for, but $19 for a milkshake is hard to accept.  Even the standard flavors (chocolate, vanilla, etc) are $9.  Yes, my $12 Hawaiian sundae was delicious.  I get it, it's a special event type place.... but... really?  Ultimately, they are busy so this is working for them and that's great.But I didn't walk out feeling it was reasonable.
First and last time I ever have this place, ordered two burritos for my coworker and I both really soggy!! The cook wasn't even wearing a mask.
Love this little family spot! Known Michelle & the family for many years & always just as good & great service!
The rice is SO good. The fried chicken tacos are to die for. Don´t think you are getting authentic food, but it is great. The doughnuts are not the greatest, but guys that rice makes up for it!
Love this place! Went for a quite dinner with a friend and the food as was delicious and service was perfect. This is our new go to spot.

Food is like going home... Okay fine- good food.. Not only is the food great,the atmosphere is what is needed after a bad day. The dynamic between the staff is a reality show that gives you a feeling of warmth and love. I was so loved and cared for after I left. I will go back!!

My husband and I dined in and we're so happy to see masks are required, hand sanitizer when you walk in and social distanced tables. We also had to wait for our table outside to ensure the social distancing rules applied. The staff were all fantastic and friendly. We ordered the chorizo Benny with homefries and a cheese omelette with chorizo and a biscuit with gravy. Everything was so delicious we cleaned our plates! We can't wait to return!

A cute store, once of its kind in the area! It's not easy to find a Japanese store like this, there's a restaurant side as well, and they have takeout available if you are craving some Japanese cuisine! 

The market offers a variety of items from fresh fruits and vegetables to exotic drink, snacks and miscellaneous condiments and beauty products.

You can also find small decorations and PENS! Why did I say PENS? Japanese PENS are different! Go try it for yourself!

However I do think there's too much empty spaces on shelves which is an eyesore.

Okay, now I have to go hangout with My Neighbor Totoro, Ciao!

Made our first visit here before an event at Parnassus and if won't be our last. The food was fresh, creative  & delicious and the service was excellent! Kale hummus was tasty and the chicken noodle soup was a delight.
I was very excited to try this place but was disappointed with their chicken kebob sandwich which later gave me a severe stomachache. The only good thing about my experience was the mint lemonade.

The food was AMAZING!!! Huge tasty portions on the plates. The server was very kind, kept checking up on us, but not too much. It was bright inside. Clean. Although I forgot to check out their bathroom. They have a little bakery counter and plenty of beautiful sweets like cheesecake and other kinds of cakes. There is a counter you can dine at or in the booths. My boyfriend and I really enjoyed our late night dining experience at Ritz Diner. Definitely 5 stars and WILL be visiting again! The menu has lots to offer. Great place to go if you're hungry or after a fun night out.

This was definitely one of my favorites in Santa Barbara!! The food and staff were excellent!! The fried pickles!! Blown away on the flavor and dipping sauce. The tots!! My daughter couldn't have eaten them faster.

Well, we went for the first time last night and this place is everything everyone says it is. Service, style, food, everything. I would tell every tourist to put Skull's on their list. We tried wedge salads, crab cakes, meatball appetizer, filet, and pork chop. Everyone at the table sampled the pork chop and we all agreed it was the best we have ever had anywhere. The meatballs are awesome too, a mix of ground prime rib and filet mignon, 2 large ones served 4 of use nicely. We didn't get to hear the jazz cause we had a show at the Ryman but we will go back soon and get a later reservation. Go!!!

Five stars because Vic's sushi is by far the most simple, convenient, and fresh sushi that fits perfectly in my lifestyle. Only sad part is that I've moved and now live 30 mins from Hatboro and can't have this every week. 
My common order includes: 
Pad Thai (shrimp or chicken) - the noddles are cooked perfectly with great portions and a lime on the side. The lime over this dish is the best! 
Penang Curry (shrimp) - always shrimp because the way the shrimp is prepared is just delicious, it's well cooked and the flavors of the curry is absorbed throughly. 
Three roll special (Alaska roll - avocado & salmon, tuna roll and yellow tail roll) I always ask for the rice to be wrapped on the outside. I just like the feel/texture of the rice outside of the seaweed.

Biera actually brews their own beer in-house   and their plates are meant to be shared! All their dishes are delicious  and very different! They have an outdoor patio as well!
